acquisition.worker_canary: Unchanged consumer case0 fresh/brownfield ZIP/TAR install, synthetic update/conflict/repair/removal/partial-recovery acceptance on actual downloaded paths. Original assertions unchanged; no source or model suite repeated.

completion_gate: Tag/release/upload and all4 downloads must match; native acquired-byte fresh/brownfield/update consumers must complete with full custody, quiescence, retirement and released reservation. Stable source qualification alone is not publication completion.

effects.consumer: One native managed original case0 on downloaded bytes; fixed finite wait/allocation, unchanged reserve and256MiB aggregate; collect full outputs, retire scratch, release reservation.
effects.download: One HTTPS acquisition per asset; exclusive writes with frozen per-file and4MiB total byte caps; cooperative120s deadline checked between reads and30s socket inactivity timeout; no hard total wall-time guarantee. Approved existing .aide/release parent.
effects.other_branches: All88 remote-head preimages remain unchanged;85other tips preserved; no clone/worktree/source mutation.
effects.publication: One GitHub Release with these4 assets and exact notes through Jules/Julesc013. No external paid service or API billing route.
effects.tag: One annotated immutable tag on exact synchronized main, only if no tags or releases exist. Ordinary tag push, no force/retag.

enforcement.aggregate_artifact_accounting: Publisher holds the existing estate admission lock during exact effects/downloads and stock bounded inventory includes existing .aide/release plus4MiB download reservation and next worker allowance. Acquired-byte observer separately inventories release artifacts read-only, then existing runner performs fresh locked worker admission. This is cooperative/monitored, not filesystem quota or a guarantee over unrelated processes.
enforcement.download_retention: Keep the4 downloaded release evidence assets, at most4MiB, in the existing release tree. No cache family, full source copy or unknown deletion.
enforcement.native_worker: Previously qualified selected CodexSandboxOffline write confinement and Windows Job memory/process limits.
enforcement.publisher: Exact reviewed bounded parent Git/GitHub/HTTPS operation, not covered by worker sandbox. Actual current controller/editor/plugin routes remain unrestricted.
enforcement.resource_limits: Cooperative monitored admission/scratch/disk headroom, not a hard filesystem/global quota.

preserved_rejected_download_path_proposa.finding: Proposed untracked download directory would violate required clean-state guard after publication; caught and corrected before any tag, upload or download. Existing *.log ignore rule applies to exact new subtree; clean guard unchanged.
